instruction: Configure Thunderbird to locally mark all future emails from microsoft.com as read using a message filter.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a message filter to mark emails as read from microsoft.com domain. The evaluator checks the msgFilterRules.dat file for a filter with enabled='yes', action='Mark read', and condition checking sender ends with 'microsoft.com'. Uses existing check_thunderbird_filter metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly reads the Thunderbird message filter configuration file (msgFilterRules.dat) to verify filter creation
Metric function check_thunderbird_filter properly parses filter file format and matches against expected rules
Expected values are semantically correct: enabled='yes', action='Mark read', condition='AND (from,ends with,microsoft.com)' accurately represent the instruction requirements
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all three critical aspects (enabled status, action type, filter condition)
Proper error handling: metric returns 0.0 when file retrieval fails (result is None)
Appropriate postconfig: closes Message Filters window and sleeps to ensure Thunderbird saves filter changes before verification
Data flow is correct: postconfig ensures clean state → getter retrieves saved filter file → metric verifies filter configuration
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor type compatibility warning exists (get_vm_file returns Union[Optional[str], List[Optional[str]]] but metric expects str), though runtime logic handles None correctly with explicit check at thunderbird.py:90-91

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
